{{Quote|Do you think that Malak's powers were weakened by Revan's lightsaber?|[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]|<ref name="Darth Plagueis (novel)">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
The '''Duel on Darth Revan's Flagship''' was a confrontation during the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Malak]]. It took place in [[Darth Revan's flagship|Revan's flagship]]. The [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] resulted in Malak's defeat and the loss of his jaw.

==Prelude==
At some point during the war, Malak openly viewed his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] as being soft, causing tension between the two that culminated in a lightsaber duel.<ref name="KotOR CG" />

==The duel==
Malak's jaw was removed by a lightsaber strike from Revan, and Malak was forced to wear a [[Cybernetics/Legends|large metal prosthesis cover]] over where his jaw had once been. A [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] allowed Malak to talk, but his voice now reverberated with a gruff electronic tone.<ref name="KotOR CG" />
